trust: Version-controlled engineering input only; never bind from HTTP/offline requests or grant authority from a task label.
ready: Exact immutable source version/locator and literal AC recorded
Owner role, scope, dependency dispositions and scoped pending decisions recorded
All seven impact assessments include reasons and actual references
Meaningful implementation and test authoring planned; deferred execution does not forbid draft authoring
done: Implementation and meaningful tests authored; actual references retained
Required checks RUN/PASS on exact target with immutable receipt identity; authored is not run
No unresolved critical software; scoped decisions resolved for acceptance
Independent exact-target QA/source review with genuinely validated reviewer authority; author cannot self approve
Documentation, audit/offline/security/regulatory effects reconciled; coordinator handles publication
executionPolicy: User deferral: all execution DEFERRED_NOT_RUN until larger foundation authored. No check is waived; no acceptance inferred.
